The '''Tantive system''' {{Pronounced|ˈtæntɪˌvi}} contained the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Tantive IV (planet)|Tantive IV]] and [[Tantive V]]. In honor of diplomats from Tantive IV who visited Alderaan, the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Star of Alderaan'']] was renamed ''Tantive IV''.
